name: The Eltari Nexus
notes: A previously unknown quantum phenomenon discovered deep within the Eltari Nebula (loc_eltari_nebula) — a breakthrough in quantum astroengineering with potentially era-defining implications. Discovered by a Union science team led by Dr. Adrienne Kovas (adrienne_kovas, CSO of the Judicator Prime), working alongside the Prime Construct and an AI/human research coalition. Cross-ref: loc_eltari_nebula notes.

naming_exemption.reason: Anomaly name "The Eltari Nexus" preserved verbatim from the cited expedition scenario.

promotion_to_canon.rule: owner directive: promote all staged records that do not conflict with canon
promotion_to_canon.conflict_scan: zero name/office collisions; fabric linter clean; position axis unchanged

phenomenology.nature: A naturally occurring quantum instability, not an artefact — spacetime folds into recursive energy loops.
phenomenology.effect: The fold sustains itself, generating a self-sustaining energy flux described as a near-inexhaustible power source.
phenomenology.significance: Natural origin matters: it makes the Nexus a discovery to be contested rather than a construction to be attributed, which is consistent with it being framed as a breakthrough find in the Eltari Nebula rather than as precursor engineering.

source_caveat.caveat: One passage in the same source states explicitly that it is not a historical record and is not evidence that the Eltari Nexus exists in canon.
source_caveat.handling: Recorded rather than dropped. It does not negate this record — the entity is CANON on separate evidence — but it does mean that narrative excerpt carries no independent weight, and any later pass re-reading it should not treat it as attestation.

prose_ledger_triage.excluded: None — all three claims are recorded, including the disclaimer.
